name: Land and Easement Acquisition Program (LEAP)

funder.name: Peter and Carmen Lucia Buck Foundation

summary: Grants that close funding gaps for land trusts buying land or conservation easements that are ready to close, in the Hudson River and Lake Champlain watersheds of New York, all of Connecticut and select Maine watersheds. Applicants must be Land Trust Alliance members and accredited, or on the path to accreditation within two years.

geography.label: Hudson River and Lake Champlain watersheds (NY), Connecticut, select Maine watersheds

calls.label: FY2028 LEAP cycle
calls.note: Formal applications are by invitation only, due end of August 2027.
